review_notes: I read the whole file. It declares no @[simp] lemmas, so I looked for places where a missing simp lemma or attribute makes the proofs repeat work. I checked the definitions of productA/productB and their coordinate lemmas in ThreeCoupledNormedSpace.lean. I also grepped for other uses of the threeProfilePoint_* lemmas. I did not run Lean, so I make no claim about observed simp behaviour or loops. I found no rewrite cycles or competing rules, because there are no simp rules in the file to compete. The suggestions are about missing canonical simp coverage.

findings.problem: These three coordinate-evaluation lemmas for the concrete point `threeProfilePoint` are the normal form for the point's coordinates, but none is tagged `@[simp]`. Every caller must pass them by hand: `norm_num [threeProfileCenter,threeProfilePoint_zero]` at lines 116 and 118, and `simp [productA_re,productA_im,threeProfileCenter,threeProfilePoint_zero,threeProfilePoint_one]` at lines 278 and 634. `threeProfileCenter` is also unfolded manually each time, and there is no simp lemma for its first component such as `threeProfileCenter.1 = threeProfilePoint`. Callers therefore have to know which lemmas to list. The `exact threeProfilePoint_one` at line 117 also shows the manual style.
findings.proposed_change: Mark the three coordinate lemmas `@[simp]`. Their left-hand sides are a coordinate projection applied to a constant, so there is no loop risk. Add `@[simp] lemma threeProfileCenter_fst : threeProfileCenter.1 = threeProfilePoint := rfl`. After that, `simp` closes the goals at lines 116–118 and the `Complex.ext` goals at 278 and 634 without listing the point lemmas or unfolding `threeProfileCenter`.
findings.benefit: Call sites become short, `simp` alone gives the right coordinates, and a reader no longer has to remember which of three lemmas each site needs.

findings.declaration: threeGlobalLog_local (hA0) and threeNormalInv_clean_eventually (h0): duplicated `productA threeProfileCenter.1 = 3/5` proof
findings.problem: The fact that `productA` at the profile centre equals `3/5` is proved by the same local `have` in two places, at lines 276–279 and 632–634. Each proof needs the same list of `productA_re`, `productA_im`, `threeProfileCenter` and the point lemmas. The same pattern is also needed at line 217 (`simp only [Complex.normSq_apply,productA_re,productA_im,...]`) and line 261. `productA_re` and `productA_im` are plain lemmas in the other file, not simp lemmas, so they must be named at every call site. No canonical simp lemma gives the value of `productA`, or its norm, at this concrete centre.
findings.proposed_change: Add one top-level lemma, for example `@[simp] lemma productA_threeProfileCenter : productA threeProfileCenter.1 = (3/5:ℂ)`, and optionally `‖productA threeProfileCenter.1‖ = 3/5`. Prove it once with the existing `Complex.ext` argument. Replace both local `he` blocks with it. Also consider tagging `productA_re`, `productA_im`, `productB_re` and `productB_im` in ThreeCoupledNormedSpace.lean as `@[simp]`. Their left-hand sides are projections of an opaque definition and their right-hand sides are strictly simpler, so they cannot loop. Then the `simp only [...]` lists at lines 217 and 261 shrink.
findings.benefit: This removes duplicated proof text and gives the centre value one canonical, discoverable simp form. It also lets the `simp [..., productA_re, productA_im, ...]` argument lists be dropped.
